label: JZ Mock E · Paper 2 · Question 8
knowledgePattern: Keep both angle branches before optimising a unique triangle
solution:
Let α be the acute angle with sinα=1/3. The two allowed values of A are α and π−α. For a given x=cosC, there is at most one angle C∈(0,π), since cosine is strictly decreasing there.

If A=α, a nondegenerate triangle exists exactly when 0<C<π−α. If A=π−α, it exists exactly when 0<C<α. In either allowed case, two angles and side AB fix one triangle up to congruence. When both exist they are distinct: the triangle with obtuse A has angle π−α, whereas neither other angle in the acute-A triangle can equal it because C is positive.

Exactly one triangle therefore exists for α≤C<π−α. The largest cosine on this interval is attained at C=α. Its value is 1−(1/3)2=22/3. The other branch at that boundary has zero third angle and is excluded. Answer D.

hints.title: Keep both possible angles
hints.body: Call the acute angle with the given sine α. Write the other possible value of angle A too.
hints.recap: Equal positive sine values can belong to supplementary angles.
hints.pitfall: A triangle angle is strictly between zero and a straight angle.
hints.pause: List the two possible values of A.

recall.reminder: Equal positive sine values can belong to supplementary angles.

hints.title: Check the third angle
hints.body: For each possible A, use B=π−A−C and require B>0. Shade the two resulting ranges on rows of one number line for C.
hints.recap: A valid triangle must have three positive angles.
hints.pitfall: A third angle of zero is a collapsed triangle.
hints.pause: Find where exactly one of the two triangles is possible.

recall.reminder: A valid triangle must have three positive angles.

hints.title: Choose the greatest cosine
hints.body: Cosine decreases as a triangle angle increases. Use the allowed range of C to choose the relevant endpoint, then calculate its cosine from the given sine.
hints.recap: The largest value must occur at an allowed angle.
hints.pitfall: Check whether the endpoint itself gives one valid triangle.

recall.reminder: The largest value must occur at an allowed angle.
